title: LA City General Fund postings, August 2025 vs August 2024

attempts.text: The City of Los Angeles General Fund posted a decrease of $0.6 million in August 2025 compared to August 2024, reflecting a 6.0% increase in the year-to-date postings. The largest movers in the General Fund were Non-Departmental - Liability Claims, which increased by $23.1 million, and Non-Departmental - General, which increased by $16.6 million.

final_text: General Fund postings were $667.7m in August 2025, down 0.6% from $671.7m in August 2024. Year-to-date postings were $1.30bn, up 0.5%. The largest movements were: Non-Departmental - Liability Claims decreased by $23.1m; Non-Departmental - General increased by $16.6m; Fire increased by $9.6m.
